states.summary: Paid PMPM increased by $83.10 (+61.7%) consistently across the period, from $134.71 to $217.81.

drivers.title: What's Driving the Change
description: The change is primarily driven by Utilization — Admit Impact: $64.95 PMPM, Cost per Admit Impact: $18.15 PMPM.

drivers.title: What Services are Driving It
description: The change is concentrated in Misc Disorders Nutrition/Metabolism w MCC (DRG 640) and ECMO/Trach w MV >96h w Major OR (DRG 003), together accounting for approximately $1.75 of PMPM change.
Acute MSK accounts for the largest condition-level impact with $37.14 PMPM change.
Medicare HMO accounts for the largest product-level impact with PMPM changing by $-92.80.

drivers.title: Which Providers Are Driving It

additional_signals: New member mix changed by -2.6 percentage points, from 10.0% to 7.4%.
NPAR activity changed by +140.1%. IDR cases changed by +0, indicating no network pricing pressure.
